blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Accounting is the language of Czarnikow's numbers. Today's lesson is Small Company Accounts. It gives you short, useful sentences for the finance team.

Today you learn five easy words: entry, ledger, folder, shelf, and desk. You also practise this, that, these, and those. The sentences are short and simple.

Go slowly. One step at a time. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: What is the lesson about?
items.why: "Today's lesson is Small Company Accounts."

items.q: How many new words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn five easy words: entry, ledger, folder, shelf, and desk."

items.q: The sentences in the lesson are…
items.why: "The sentences are short and simple."

items.q: "Go slowly. One step at a time." This suggests that the lesson wants you to…
items.why: Inferência: "one step at a time" pede calma, não pressa.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: you need many years to learn them
the words are useful for the finance team
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que as frases são úteis para o time de finanças.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falando com um novo trainee. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to the team. My name is Sophie. I work with small company accounts. Today I show you the basics.

Look. This is a ledger. It is a big book of numbers. That folder on the shelf is also for accounts. These papers on my desk are new entries. Those files near the door are old.

An entry is one line of numbers. Every entry must be correct. We check the shelf at the end of every day. It is a simple routine, but it is very important.

Take it slowly. One step at a time. You can ask me any question. Repeat the words with me: entry, ledger, folder, shelf, desk. Very good! You are ready. Let's start.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Sophie do?
options: She works with small company accounts
items.why: "I work with small company accounts."

items.q: What is a ledger, in Sophie's words?
items.why: "This is a ledger. It is a big book of numbers."

items.q: When do they check the shelf?
options: At the end of every day
items.why: "We check the shelf at the end of every day."

items.q: Sophie says "Every entry must be correct." This suggests that in accounting…
options: speed is more important than numbers
items.why: Inferência: se toda entrada deve estar correta, a precisão é importante.

items.q: How would you best describe Sophie's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "Very good!", "You can ask me any question" e incentiva a repetição.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Please add one entry to the ledger." An entry is…
options: a line of numbers in the records
items.why: Entry = lançamento: uma linha de números nos registros.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The big book of accounts is called the ___."
items.why: Ledger = livro-razão, o grande livro de contas.

items.q: "Put the papers in the blue folder." A folder is…
items.why: Folder = pasta: guarda os papéis juntos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The books are on the top ___, near the wall."
items.why: Shelf = prateleira: onde os livros ficam.

items.q: "I write my notes at my desk." A desk is…
items.why: Desk = mesa (de trabalho).

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you fill in this form, please?" To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher, escrever as informações.

items.q: "Please check the numbers before you send them." To check means to…
options: look at them to see if they are correct
items.why: Check = conferir, verificar se está certo.

items.q: "Let's go over the entries together." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, passar por algo juntos.

items.q: "I will write down the new number." To write down means to…
items.why: Write down = anotar, pôr no papel.

items.q: "Take it step by step." This means…
options: do it slowly, one part at a time
items.why: Step by step = passo a passo, uma parte de cada vez.
